## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-*juan* method-and-notes work on the practice of contemplating the mind during sūtra-recitation, with the foundational teaching attributed to Zhìyǐ and the recording-and-elaboration to Zhànrán. Companion to [KR6d0210](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0210) (on contemplating-the-mind during eating) as part of the Tiāntái daily-practice meditative apparatus.

**Abstract**

The dating bracket spans Zhìyǐ's foundational productive period (575–597) through Zhànrán's recording-and-elaboration period (750–782).
